Finland.  This role is vital to supporting the smooth operation of a fast-paced construction site environment, ensuring the effective management and control of all project documentation in accordance with company standards.  Requirements Ensure all project documentation adheres to company standards and the Integrated Management System (IMS).   Distribute and track documents to ensure that all relevant stakeholders receive and have access to the latest versions of project documentation (including drawings, schedules, specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and reports).   Maintain and update project registers such as the document register, RFI register, action log, and issue log.   Analyse and summarise data from various project logs, highlighting outstanding actions or overdue items.   Generate regular reports to support project tracking, including document status updates and overdue reports.   Ensure accurate storage and version control of documents in compliance with project document control procedures.   Liaise with external consultants and contractors to ensure their documentation complies with project standards.   Support Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), and Health & Safety (HSE) initiatives by assisting with audits and ensuring document-related compliance.  Skills/Qualifications: Minimum of 2 years' experience in a similar site-based role  High level of verbal and written English is essential   Excellent organisation and interpersonal skills  High level of IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office Suite  Experience of knowledge sharing applications is advantageous   Benefits Opportunity to work for a market leader in the Data centre industry   Working on large scale data centre projects  Collaborative team working environments  Career progression and development supported  Competitive salary packages  Winthrop Technologies Ltd. are an equal opportunities employer. paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Document Controller position at Winthrop Technologies. With my background in legal document management and event coordination, I believe I can make a significant contribution to your team.

My experience includes drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial agreements as well as managing the full contract lifecycle from initial drafting through execution and archiving. Additionally, I have coordinated large-scale events for diverse international groups, demonstrating strong organizational skills and stakeholder liaison abilities.
I am committed to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. Currently, I am pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised).

Winthrop Technologies' reputation in the data centre industry is impressive, and I am eager to contribute to your large-scale projects. The opportunity to work for a market leader like Winthrop Technologies aligns perfectly with my career goals.
I am available to start in September 2026 and look forward to discussing how I can further contribute to your team's success.
